text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
............Mmmph.
Follow me not...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I am not following you.
We simply happen to be heading in the same direction... Hmph.
choice_data_list: What on earth is that about...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, it happens from time to time~.
It's a roommate duo 'war', you see, a war.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Apparently they squabble every now and then
over differences in their daily habits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, but they always go right back to normal, you know?

However, the next day...
The 'war' was still ongoing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
............
For what purpose are you here?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Canst thou not see? 
No other seats were vacant!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't it dragging on longer than usual this time...?! 
Sparks are flying, let's keep our distance~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah~, that mood is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Miracle-chan today,
the atmosphere became so nice and wa~rm.
♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right...
I've been getting praised a lot lately, after all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I do have that kind of talent?
I just might... right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... alright!
I guess it couldn't hurt to just ask!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, you two~! Mind if I sit here~?
Man, it sure is crowded today, haha...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Miracle! 'Tis fine, 'tis fine, sit! 
Yaen—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Ahem! Scoot over to that side yourself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, yes!
Hishi Miracle-san, please come this way...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks~. Ehehe...
So, um~, you two... Ah~, well...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter?
Thou seemest somewhat lacking in spirit...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wilt thou have some taiyaki?
Behold, there is custard cream as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, using such things as a distraction...!
Or rather, wasn't Hishi Miracle-san
just about to have her lunch?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What of it, is a little not fine?!
Wilt thou get angry even when it is not midnight?
Let people eat their snacks as they please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm...? Midnight? Snacks?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Could the reason for your fight be...?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-I was so terribly famished that sleep would not come...
Yet I...! Made sure to eat ever so quietly
so as not to wake thee, Yaeno...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The issue is not the noise...!
It is undeniably bad for your health.
Greasy deep-fried rice crackers in the middle of the night... really!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What?! 'Bad for my health'...?
Wast thou not in a towering rage
because thou hadst been awakened?!

Apparently, there had been a slight misunderstanding.
After taking a moment to talk calmly, the two shook hands and reconciled with smiles on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew~, I'm so glad things are back to normal~.
choice_data_list: It was all thanks to you, Hishi Miracle!
It was all thanks to you, Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah... was it, really?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, they didn't even need me here at all, did they?!

She was likely the catalyst for starting the conversation.
Hishi Miracle puts those around her at ease just by being present.
However, she certainly wasn't the direct factor...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They were right on the verge of making up anyway~.
And yet I went and meddled awkwardly~...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I really am completely ordina~ry after all~...
Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Haaah~, what a foolish 'war' that was~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I still have much to learn...
In contrast, Hishi Miracle-san maintains
her composure under any circumstance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Look upon that tranquil countenance!
As expected, she is not to be underestimated!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle-san looks so gentle and fluffy again...!
Ngh, I must protect her...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hah, this one is hardly the type
who requireth protecting.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Geez, what's that supposed to mean~? I don't know how to feel about that~...
